paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.00% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.31%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.98%). Brent crude changed +3.24% to 95.77. Gold changed -2.97% to 3,881.7. Bitcoin changed -3.51% to 71,371.6094. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.103%, a relative move of +2.10%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (+5.65%) and Newmont (-4.92%) moved the most.
